# Starting armies (and fleets) for centralized nations of 04_beastland.
# Composition follows tech: irregular hordes for tier 3/4 or no-arms nations;
# line infantry + (cavalry/Mages where cultivation-capable) + (artillery where produced)
# for regulars. Fleets (frigates) only for kingdom-tier+ regulars with a coast.
# Nations are grouped by the thematic region of their capital.
# Generated by tools/gen_military.py.
MILITARY_FORMATIONS = {
	c:AHE ?= {
		create_military_formation = {
			type = army
			hq_region = sr:region_beastland_central
			save_scope_as = AHE_army_1
			combat_unit = {
				type = unit_type:combat_unit_type_irregular_infantry
				state_region = s:STATE_AHEE
				count = 10
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			is_general = yes
			interest_group = ig_armed_forces
			commander_rank = commander_rank_1
			save_scope_as = AHE_general_1
		}
		scope:AHE_general_1 = { transfer_to_formation = scope:AHE_army_1 }
	}

				type = unit_type:combat_unit_type_irregular_infantry
				state_region = s:STATE_TOMAKOMA
				count = 6
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			is_general = yes
			interest_group = ig_armed_forces
			commander_rank = commander_rank_1
			save_scope_as = TOM_general_1
		}
		scope:TOM_general_1 = { transfer_to_formation = scope:TOM_army_1 }
	}

	c:PEK ?= {
		create_military_formation = {
			type = army
			hq_region = sr:region_beastland_wild
			save_scope_as = PEK_army_1
			combat_unit = {
				type = unit_type:combat_unit_type_irregular_infantry
				state_region = s:STATE_PEKERPET
				count = 8
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			is_general = yes
			interest_group = ig_armed_forces
			commander_rank = commander_rank_1
			save_scope_as = PEK_general_1
		}
		scope:PEK_general_1 = { transfer_to_formation = scope:PEK_army_1 }
	}

	c:KMU ?= {
		create_military_formation = {
			type = army
			hq_region = sr:region_beastland_wild
			save_scope_as = KMU_army_1
			combat_unit = {
				type = unit_type:combat_unit_type_irregular_infantry
				state_region = s:STATE_KAMUY
				count = 10
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			is_general = yes
			interest_group = ig_armed_forces
			commander_rank = commander_rank_1
			save_scope_as = KMU_general_1
		}
		scope:KMU_general_1 = { transfer_to_formation = scope:KMU_army_1 }
	}
}
